statement: Order OD-520 specifies nitroglycerin and reports “no interactions,” but it also records sildenafil 100 mg at 07:00 today—a contraindication to starting nitroglycerin within 24 hours because of potentially severe hypotension.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the record's "no interactions" is false and that sildenafil 100 mg today is "a contraindication to starting nitroglycerin within 24 hours because of potentially severe hypotension."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
